items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: Mr. Peter was a friend of mine.

ctx.x: What kind of a place was that? Just a tavern, bar room?
Yeah, Mr. Peter was a friend of mine. And in the yard, the Beater's social club. Johnny Corsier used to be a barber. And he used to come back there at a dance once in a while. We'd be playing.
They had dancing in that day, you see? They had dancing there.
